description: This file defines a custom NSView subclass and a SwiftUI NSViewRepresentable struct for rendering a highlighted menu item with hover effects in a macOS application.

classes.name: HighlightedMenuItemHostView
classes.description: A custom NSView that displays a SwiftUI view with hover highlight effects and manages layout and event handling.

methods.name: init(rootView:width:)
methods.description: Initializes the HighlightedMenuItemHostView with a SwiftUI view and a specified width.

methods.name: update(rootView:width:)
methods.description: Updates the view's root view and width, refreshing highlight state.

methods.name: updateHighlight()
methods.description: Updates the environment variable to reflect hover state and triggers layout updates.

methods.name: updateSizing()
methods.description: Adjusts the size of the hosting view and the NSView frame based on current content and width.
